business_description: Stable program identifier used to reconcile finance budget rows to programs and use cases
validation_rule: Approved programs must appear in 09 and SA04 and tie to 08 or SA02
Must map to the related program_code when applicable

business_description: Semicolon-delimited list of 08 budget row IDs that fund the program or use case
validation_rule: Required when funding_status is approved or active

business_description: Semicolon-delimited list of source finance extract rows supporting the funding
validation_rule: Required when funding_status is approved or active
not_approved rows must not carry approved_funding_usd

business_description: Classifies spend as run or change
validation_rule: Run plus change must reconcile to the tenant technology budget

business_description: Controls whether a row participates in rollups
validation_rule: Only additive_budget_fact rows count in total budget

business_description: Explains whether a row could double-count with platform/program/use-case spend
validation_rule: AI spend aggregates must not double-count overlapping rows

business_description: Marks whether the row is AI-related
validation_rule: true rows must also set ai_spend_type and ai_spend_category
candidate_ai_opportunity must not carry approved funding unless explicitly sourced

business_description: Indicates AI capability embedded in a platform or SaaS spend line
validation_rule: Embedded AI must not be counted as standalone AI Assist funding

business_description: Non-additive AI amount inside a broader budget row
validation_rule: Sum as AI lens only; do not add to total budget
Must be zero when funding_status is not_approved

business_description: Value promised by a business case or vendor
validation_rule: Must not be presented as realized value

business_description: Value validated by finance with actuals
Whether Tower may show a value claim
validation_rule: yes requires finance_validated_value_usd and source evidence
